description.p: A desktop front end for the ANUBIS file encryption engine: hybrid X25519 and ML-KEM-1024 key encapsulation, ML-DSA-87 signatures, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 STREAM payloads.

The application drives the anubis engine, reads its JSON, and draws it. It holds no key material, derives no secret, performs no cryptography, and reaches no verification verdict of its own. A field the engine did not state is rendered as not stated, never as a pass.
Identities and recipients are handled by fingerprint rather than by key, because an ANUBIS recipient runs to roughly 2573 bech32 characters and no person compares that.
